text_rules.name: url
text_rules.description: Web links. Keeps the signal that a link existed without keeping its destination.

text_rules.name: phone_pe
text_rules.description: Peruvian mobile phone numbers (9XXXXXXXX, optionally with +51).

text_rules.name: id_number_pe
text_rules.description: Peruvian RUC (11 digits) or DNI (8 digits) numbers written right after the keyword RUC/DNI. Only the capture group "value" is replaced, not the keyword. A natural-person RUC (starts with 10) embeds the DNI, so it identifies someone.

text_rules.name: person_name
text_rules.description: Person names, detected via spaCy es_core_news_lg NER (PER entities).

text_rules.name: known_names
text_rules.description: Names/surnames from a local, never-committed list (e.g. the chat owners). Whole-word, case- and accent-insensitive; consecutive names merge into one span.
